newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: EU puts priority on housing the homeless.
newsitem.headline: EU puts priority on housing the homeless.

text.p: The European Union said on Friday that providing housing for the homeless was a vital element in any integrated approach to tackling social exclusion across Europe.

"While housing is rarely seen as the single or, indeed, the prime factor underlying social exclusion, good quality housing can help prevent or alleviate the effects of social exclusion," Ireland's Housing Minister Liz McManus told a news conference.
She was speaking after Ireland, the current EU president, hosted an informal meeting of EU housing ministers based on the theme "Housing for socially-excluded people."
McManus said a statement issued after the talks identified important pointers for the future direction of housing policy in tackling the problem of social exclusion.
"These included in particular physical renewal of housing, improved layout and design, greater social mix, better estate management and more community involvement and tenant participation," she said.
McManus said the ministers also agreed that particular emphasis should be placed on successful pilot or demonstration projects which could be replicated in other member countries.
